275184378.description:
Product Overview:
This collection includes a variety of mineral and rock specimens featuring polished and raw stones. Included are carved sandstone, quartz geode, cubic calcite, amethyst cluster, and a bright blue-green crystal possibly fluorite or amazonite. Additional specimens include geode halves, black tourmaline, clear quartz, polished agate slices, obsidian, and various sedimentary and metamorphic rocks.

Specifications:
- Types of Specimens: Sandstone, quartz geode, calcite, amethyst, fluorite/amazonite, black tourmaline, clear quartz, agate, obsidian, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks
- Condition: Natural variations in color and texture present
- Appearance: Mixture of polished and raw stones
- Sizes: Range from small fragments to larger hand-sized pieces
- Display: Suitable for visual examination and study
